# TechTarget

> > TechTarget is a global network of enterprise technology websites providing news, analysis, and expert insights on IT infrastructure, AI, cloud computing, storage, and business technology.

TechTarget operates specialized technology publications serving IT professionals with in-depth coverage of emerging technologies including AI agents, containers, vector databases, business intelligence, and storage solutions. The network features contributions from experienced technology writers and editors covering enterprise-scale implementations and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise Technology
- AI Agents
- Containers & Virtualization
- Docker
- Vector Databases (Qdrant)
- Business Intelligence
- Storage Solutions (Pure Storage)
- Cloud Computing (IaaS, PaaS)
- Salesforce & Agentforce
- Customer Experience & Contact Centers
- Context Management
- Natural Language Processing
- IT/OT Convergence
- ComputerWeekly.com.br

## Home

- [TechTarget - Global Network of Information Technology Websites and Contributors](https://www.techtarget.com): TechTarget homepage covering enterprise tech, AI, containers, and storage
